securityDecisions.label: BUY_STARTER
securityDecisions.case: Preferred first duration step with ~4.8–4.9y duration, 0.03% fee, ~4.52% SEC yield (September dated); avoids TLT long-bond risk.

securityDecisions.killGate: 10Y real yields/term premium rebound with oil inflation while credit stabilizes; USD/MYR mismatch
securityDecisions.sizeRule: Small-to-medium liquid fixed-income sleeve; final weight requires cash, FX and loss budget

securityDecisions.label: BUY_STARTER_ALTERNATIVE
securityDecisions.case: More duration than VGIT, benefits more from falling benchmark yields
securityDecisions.buyGate: Choose instead of overlapping VGIT if greater duration desired, stage tranches
securityDecisions.killGate: Breakdown of safe-haven bond response and 10Y yield upward breakout

securityDecisions.label: BUY_SMALL_TACTICAL_ONLY
securityDecisions.case: 10Y below 5% intraday and TLT +1.87% 22 Oct; 14.79y effective duration, 5.41% 30d SEC yield dated Oct16
securityDecisions.buyGate: Partial starter only at/under observed closing area; add if 20/30Y yields confirm lower after FOMC and oil/funding does not reverse
securityDecisions.killGate: 20Y/30Y yields jump ~50bp, inflation + term premium surge, equity rallies with steepener, position breach
securityDecisions.sizeRule: Optional satellite capped by 50bp shock loss budget; +50bp in yields implies roughly -7.4% price before income/convexity

securityDecisions.label: BUY_CASH_PARKING

securityDecisions.buyGate: Any time needing short-term USD liquidity, monitor dividend/ex-date accrued distribution
securityDecisions.killGate: Higher after-tax risk-free option / USD FX constraints

securityDecisions.label: BUY_STARTER_FUNDAMENTAL

securityDecisions.sizeRule: Limit cyclical commodity exposure and measure volatility/portfolio energy overlap
